title: Information Requirements for Resolving Implementation Impossibilities
abstract: arXiv:2610.32958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a framework for assessing implementation impossibilities through the information required to resolve them. Domain covers describe information used to select a mechanism without restricting admissible preferences. Coarsening a cover weakens the required information. In quasi-linear public decision problems with a status quo, we study two impossibilities of dominant-strategy implementation: combining efficiency and individual rationality with either budget feasibility or budget balancedness. Under an interval cover based on bounds on maximal social surplus, we characterize the social choice rules implementable in dominant strategies and satisfying the first set of axioms. Under a surplus-level cover based on exact surplus levels, we obtain the corresponding characterization for the second set of axioms. translated_title: 解决实施不可能性所需的信息条件
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个框架，通过化解实施不可能性所需的信息来评估这些不可能性。定义域覆盖描述了用于选择机制的信息，且不限制可容许的偏好。将覆盖变粗会削弱所需的信息。在带有现状选项的准线性公共决策问题中，我们研究了占优策略实施的两种不可能性：将效率和个人理性与预算可行性或预算平衡相结合。在基于最大社会剩余上界的区间覆盖下，我们刻画了在占优策略下可实施且满足第一组公理的社会选择规则；在基于精确剩余水平的剩余水平覆盖下，我们得到了满足第二组公理的相应刻画。这两种覆盖都是极小的：不存在任何严格更粗的覆盖能够在各自的要求下实现实施。这些具有经济学……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个以所需信息量来评估机制设计实施不可能性的框架，并通过两种极小的信息覆盖，刻画了在占优策略下同时满足效率、个人理性与预算约束的可实施社会选择规则。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a framework for assessing implementation impossibilities through the information required to resolve them, and uses two minimal covers to characterize social choice rules implementable in dominant strategies under efficiency, individual rationality, and budget constraints.
